# OMEGA 4-Tier Multi-Scale Observatory (v6.7.0)

> Zero-dependency Node.js ESM, Python 3, and WebGL 2.0 local cockpit supervising 8 live Artificial Life endpoints across 7 public repositories on 127.0.0.1:8790 with strict render-only D7RO observer isolation, loopback CSRF/CSWSH & path-traversal defenses, bounded bare-metal 1..1,000,000 controls, and 6/6 (100%) surgical mutation verification.

- Author: Alexander Stephen Donahue (Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA; ORCID 0009-0006-8168-9648)
- Licenses: Apache-2.0 (code) / CC-BY-4.0 (white paper & docs)
- Verification boundary: 0 local Lean 4 files (supervises 5 formal companion repos reporting 244 combined upstream Lean 4 theorems); 0/1,900 Mega-Atlas open problems retired.
